title: Twelve-bar blues in G major
raisedBecause: Seventh chords shared by both hands in the twelve-bar form: both hands change shape on every chord; the notes alone measure Beginner.
trains: The twelve-bar blues with seventh chords, struck twice a bar: the left hand plays root and fifth, the right hand only the third and seventh. From C7 to F7 both right-hand notes fall a half step; to G7 they rise.
